also: what time do you get up?
what time does the train leave?
what time does the bus come?

phrases.latin: Quotā hōrā māne surgis? — Hōrā septimā mātūtīnā.
phrases.english: What time do you get up in the morning? — At seven o’clock.

phrases.latin: Quotā hōrā trāmen meum abscēdit? — Hōrā ūndecimā.
phrases.english: At what time does my train leave? — At eleven o’clock.
What time will we get to Lisbon?

sources: Lewis & Short: quotus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 81, 211.
